description: This Java class implements the UserDetails interface from Spring Security, representing the authenticated user's principal with associated authorities and user information.

classes.name: UserPrincipal
classes.description: Represents the authenticated user details, including authorities, username, and password, implementing Spring Security's UserDetails interface.

methods.name: UserPrincipal
methods.description: Constructor initializing user and authorization groups.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns user's authorities based on auth groups.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the account is expired (always true here).

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the account is locked (always true here).

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether credentials are expired (always true here).

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled (always true here).
